about: Chapter 88 opens with a priest’s speech on God’s commandment and the choice of life or death. Elmeyas and Azaryas then read the Law before Makeda and the elders of Israel, and the Ethiopians rejoice that Zion is among them. Makeda charges her son to keep justice, love God, and avoid drink, women and trust in horses, and the Israelite lords answer with a pledge of service to the king and to Zion.

sentences.i: Chapter 88: How he told his mother how they made him king.
sentences.n: Chapter heading, a unit of its own. ኀበ here opens a title-like clause (compare the same use in ch. 87 and earlier headings), ‘how’ rather than ‘where’ (?). ዜነዋ ‘he told her’ (ዜነወ, 3ms perfect + -ዋ ‘her’) anticipates ለእሙ ‘to his mother’ (ለ- + እም ‘mother’ + -ሁ, ‘his mother’); Geʿez often doubles an object this way. ዘከመ ‘how’ (ዘ- + ከመ ‘as’). አንገሥዎ ‘they made him king’ is the causative (አ- stem) of ነገሠ ‘reign’, with -ዎ ‘him’. The ‘he’ is Menelik, called David since ch. 87.

sentences.l: And-when fell-silent these arose priest who-commands-us (?), who-with fear-of God and-tears, while trembles our-belly and-flows our-tears;
sentences.i: And when these had fallen silent, a priest rose up who gives us commands (?), with the fear of God and with tears, while our belly trembled and our tears flowed;
sentences.n: ወሶበ ‘and when’ (ወ- ‘and’ + ሶበ ‘when’) opens the narrative; the ወ- proclitic will begin most units. አርመሙ ‘they fell silent’ (?), a 3mp perfect I take, with the published glossary, as a causative-type አርመመ ‘fall silent’ (?), the stem not confirmed; ተንሥአ ‘he arose’ (3ms perfect). The priest is not named. ዘይኤዝዘነ ‘who commands us’ (ዘ- relative + imperfect of አዘዘ + -ነ ‘us’) is my reading (?): he is perhaps the Ethiopians’ own priest, speaking as their instructor. ዘምስለ ‘who (was) with’ + ፍርሀተ (construct, ‘fear-of’) እግዚኣብሔር. The two ‘while’ clauses (እንዘ ትርዕድ ‘while it trembles’) take 3fs imperfects: ትርዕድ agrees with ከርሥ ‘belly’ (singular, here treated as feminine (?)) and ትውኅዝ with አንብዕ ‘tears’ (a plural of things takes the feminine singular). ዘምስለ is rendered ‘with’ in `i`; strictly it is ‘who (is) with’. The pronoun suffixes -ነ ‘our’, -ሙ ‘their’, -ሁ ‘his’ are read on the noun (ከርሥነ, አንብዕነ) and recur throughout.

sentences.l: Into our-heart in-truth-indeed and-not falsehood existing (is) God, and-dwells in his-commandment; and-to-tell his-commandment not-he-withdraws (?) from-those who-love-him, and-those-who keep his-commandment he-is always with-them; and-now hear-them (?) these elders and-sons-of mighty-ones-of Israel, who brought verdict and-judgement which they-wrote before king Solomon and-gave-us that-not we-turn-aside to-right and-not to-left from-what they-commanded-us;
sentences.i: In our heart, in truth and not in falsehood, God exists and dwells in His commandment; and He does not withhold (?) the telling of His commandment from those who love Him, and those who keep His commandment, He is always with them. And now hear them (?), these elders and sons of the mighty ones of Israel, who brought the verdict and the judgement that they wrote before King Solomon and gave to us, that we should not turn aside to the right or to the left from what they commanded us;
sentences.n: Long unit (41 words), one sentence. ውስተ ልብነ ‘into/in our heart’: the priest’s speech opens with what the heart knows. በአማንኬ ‘in truth indeed’ (በ- ‘in’ + አማን ‘truth’ + emphatic -ኬ). ሐሰተ ‘falsehood’ with ኢኮነ ‘it is not’. ህልው ‘existing’; the sense is God’s real presence. ነጊረ ‘to tell’ (infinitive) is the subject-matter of ኢያአትት; I read ኢያአትት as ‘does not withhold’ (?), imperfect of አአተተ, a stem not well known; the published glossary reads ወያአትት in ch. 27 as ‘removes’ (?). እምእለ ‘from those who’ (እም- ‘from’ + እለ) ያፈቅርዎ ‘they love him’ (3mp imperfect + -ዎ ‘him’). ወየዐቅቡ… ይሄሉ ‘and (those who) keep… he is’ is an anacoluthon, the relative left hanging. ስምዕዮሙአ I take as an imperative ‘hear them’ (expected ስምዕዎሙ; the printed -ዮሙ and the stray -አ are unexplained) (?). መላህቅት ‘elders’ (plural of ልሂቅ ‘great one, elder’), ደቂቀ ‘sons-of’ (construct) ኀያላነ ‘mighty ones’; these are the Israelite companions of Menelik. ዘአምጽኡ ‘who brought’ (causative of መጽአ ‘come’). ኵነኔ ወፍትሐ ‘verdict and judgement’ is the pair (house: ፍትሕ ‘judgement’, ኵነኔ ‘verdict’, as in unit 6) for the law of God, brought from King Solomon (ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን). ኢንትገሐሥ ‘we should not turn aside’: a negative subjunctive in ከመ-clause; ‘right and left’ is Deuteronomy 5:32 (‘you shall not turn aside to the right or to the left’). ኢለየማን ወኢለፀጋም: ለ- ‘to’ + የማን ‘right’ / ፀጋም ‘left’. እምዘ አዘዙነ ‘from what they commanded us’ (አዘዘ ‘command’, 3mp perfect + -ነ ‘us’). ትእዛዞ in ወየዐቅቡ ትእዛዞ is the accusative ‘his commandment’ (ትእዛዝ + -ሁ), singular, used collectively.

sentences.l: And-again they-said-to-us and-made-us-understand that we-have-taken death and-life and-like man who-in-him in-his-left fire and-in-his-right water and-where he-wishes he-puts his-hand;
sentences.i: And again they spoke to us and made us understand that we have taken death and life, like a man who has fire in his left hand and water in his right, and wherever he wishes he puts out his hand;
sentences.n: ወካዕበ ‘and again’. ይቤሉነ ‘they said to us’ (ይቤሉ, 3mp perfect of the defective ይቤ ‘say’, + -ነ ‘to us’). ወአለበዉነ ‘and they made us understand’ (አለበወ, causative of ለበወ ‘understand’, + -ነ). ነሣእነ ‘we have taken’ (1cp perfect). The image of fire and water, death and life, set before a man echoes Deuteronomy 30:15, 19 and Sirach 15:16–17 (‘fire and water… life and death… whichever he chooses shall be given him’). ብእሲ ዘቦቱ ‘a man who has in him’ is the ordinary Geʿez ‘has’ (ቦቱ ‘in him’). ውስተ ፀጋሙ ‘in his left’; የማኑ ‘his right’. ይወዲ እዴሁ ‘he puts his hand’ (ወደየ ‘put’), a chosen reach.

sentences.n: ኤልምያስ ወአዛርያስ are the two named in ch. 87 (‘chief of priests’ and ‘chief of deacons’, not assigned to the two men there) who came with Menelik from Jerusalem. ወአውፅኡ ‘and they brought out’ (አውጽአ, causative of ወጽአ ‘go out’). ይእቲ መጽሐፈ ‘that book’: ይእቲ is a feminine ‘that’ although መጽሐፍ is usually masculine, and the noun carries the accusative -ä; the text is as printed. እንተ ተጽሕፈት ‘which was written’ (feminine, agreeing with ይእቲ). ንጉሠ እስራኤል ‘king-of Israel’ is construct, probably Solomon. ወአንበብዋ ‘they read it’ (አንበበ ‘read’, with -ዋ ‘it’, feminine again). መክዳ is the spelling here for Makeda (ማክዳ elsewhere). ዐበይተ ‘great ones-of’ (plural of ዐቢይ, construct) እስራኤል.

sentences.i: And furthermore He made them people of His house, for Zion is in their midst, and the dwelling-place of the glory of God, she who saves them from every evil, and blesses the fruit of their land and multiplies their cattle, and blesses the spring of their waters and blesses their labours and the fruit of their gardens, and raises their children and guards their elders, and is to them perfection and a protector (?) wherever they dwell; and they will overcome their enemy in every place they go.
sentences.n: ወዓዲ ‘and moreover’. ረሰዮሙ ‘He made them’ (ረሰየ, with -ሙ) ሰብአ ቤቱ ‘men-of his house’, i.e. household of God. ሀለወት ጽዮን ‘Zion is’, feminine verb: Zion is the Ark (ታቦት) present among the Ethiopians, the central claim of the Kebra Nagast. ማኅደረ ስብሐቲሁ ‘dwelling-of his glory’ is a construct chain, in apposition; እንተ ታድኅኖሙ ‘she who saves them’ (እንተ feminine relative, referring back to Zion). ታድኅን, ትባርክ, ታበዝኅ, ታልህቅ, ተዐቅብ: a run of 3fs imperfects, all with Zion as subject (the forms could equally be 2ms); the ታ- of ታድኅን, ታበዝኅ, ታልህቅ is the 3fs prefix ት- joined to the causative አ-, while ትባርክ and ተዐቅብ are plain G forms. The blessings echo Deuteronomy 28:3–12 (fruit of the land, increase of cattle). ኳላ ‘protector’ is uncertain to me (?), and I pair ፍጽመ ‘perfection’ with it. ዘኀደሩ and ኀበ ሖሩ are perfects (‘where they dwelt’, ‘where they went’), read in `l`/`i` as general presents (ኀበ ‘where’). ርሡኣኒሆሙ ‘their elders’ (ርሡእ, ‘aged’ (?)). ይመውኡ ‘they overcome’ (3mp imperfect of ሞዐ ‘conquer’ (?), the lemma my best identification; the printed አ stands where ዐ is expected) takes ፀሮሙ ‘their enemy’ as object.

sentences.n: ንግሥትኒ ‘the queen, too’ (-ኒ ‘also, and’ on the noun). ትቤሎ ለወልዳ ‘she said to him, to her son’: ትቤ is the 3fs of ይቤ, with -ሎ ‘to him’ anticipating ለወልዳ (ለ- + ወልድ + -ሃ ‘her’), the doubled-object pattern again. ወልድየ ‘my son’. ወሀበከ ‘gave you’. ርትዐ ‘justice, right’; ባቲ ‘in her’ is feminine though ርትዕ is masculine, a mismatch I keep (?). ሖር ‘go’ (imperative). ‘Right or left’ is the same Deuteronomy 5:32 phrase as in unit 2; the Queen repeats the priest’s words.

sentences.i: ‘You, guard him and teach him the way to the kingdom of God, and the honouring of her, of Zion our lady; and whatever our lady does not love, let us not do. Tell us exactly, for ever, from generation to generation, so that she will not be angry with us if we do not make her work good, and so that God, too, may dwell with us;
sentences.n: አንትሙ ‘you (pl.)’. ዕቀብዎ ወመሀርዎ ‘guard him’ and ‘teach him’ (imperatives with -ዎ ‘him’; the ‘him’ is the king). ፍኖተ ለመንግሥተ ‘way to the kingdom’; መንግሥተ is construct (‘kingdom-of’) before እግዚኣብሔር. ወአክብሮታ ‘and honouring her’ (verbal noun of አክበረ + -ሃ ‘her’), then ለጽዮን ‘Zion’. እግዝእትነ ‘our lady’: the Ark is the lady of the Ethiopians. ኢንግበር ‘let us not do’ (jussive). ንግሩነ ‘tell us’ (imperative). በአስተጠናቅቆ ‘with exactness’ (አስተጠናቀቀ ‘be careful’; I take this noun-form (?)). ለትውልደ ትውልድ ‘for generation-of generation’, construct again, a form of ‘for ever’ (compare ለዓለመ ዓለም in ch. 87). ከመ ኢትትመዐዐነ: ‘lest she be angry with us’ (ተመዐዐ (?), the verb not confirmed). ለእመ ‘if’; ኢያሠነይነ ‘we do not make good’. ወእግዚኣብሔርኒ ‘and God also’ (-ኒ ‘also’) opens a second ከመ-clause, ‘that God too may dwell with us’.

sentences.l: And-you-also, O my-son, hear word-of your-fathers and-go by-their-counsel; not-make-you-foolish drink and-not women and-not trust-in garments and-not bridling-of horses and-not looking-at goods-of field former and-latter (?), but let-be your-trust in-God and-in-Zion ark-of law-his of-God your-creator, that you-overcome your-enemy and-be-many your-seed upon earth and-be-subdued (?) your-foes and-your-enemy near and-far ፨
sentences.i: And you also, my son, hear the word of your fathers and walk in their counsel. Let not drink make you foolish, nor women, nor trust in garments, nor the bridling of horses, nor the sight of the goods of the field, of former or of latter (?); but let your trust be in God and in Zion, the Ark of God’s law, God your Creator, that you may overcome your enemy and your seed may be many upon the earth, and your foes be brought low (?), your enemy near and far.’
sentences.n: ወአንተኒ ‘and you also’ (-ኒ). ኦወልድየ ‘O my son’ (ኦ vocative). ስማዕ ‘hear’ (imperative). ቃለ አበዊከ ‘word-of your fathers’, construct. ሖር በምክሮሙ ‘go in their counsel’. ኢያእብድከ ‘let it not make you foolish’ (አእበደ, causative of ‘be mad’), with subjects ስታይ ‘drink’ and ኢአንስት ‘women’ (አንስት); the string of ኢ- phrases (ወኢአስተምክሖ አልባስ ‘nor reliance on garments’, ወአልጒሞ አፍራስ ‘nor the bridling of horses’) is a warning against luxury and horse-trust (compare Psalm 20:7 and Deuteronomy 17:16–17). ኢነጽሮ ንዋየ ሐቅል ዘቅድም ወዘድኅር: ‘nor looking at the goods/vessels-of field of the first and the last’ — the phrase ንዋየ ሐቅል (‘field goods/gear’) is unclear to me and I give the plainest reading (?). Then the positive turn: አላ ‘but’; ትውክልትከ ‘your trust’; ታቦተ ሕጉ ‘ark-of his law’ in apposition to Zion; ፈጣሪከ ‘your creator’. ትማዕ ‘you overcome’ (a subjunctive of ሞዐ (?), as ይመውኡ in unit 7); ይግረሩ ‘be subdued’ (?), a rare verb; ጸላእትከ ‘your foes’, ፀርከ ‘your enemy’; ዘቅሩብ ወዘርሑቅ ‘the near and the far’. A 40-word unit, kept whole.

sentences.n: ወእሙንቱኒ ‘and they too’ (ወ- + እሙንቱ ‘they’ + -ኒ). ደቂቀ ኀይል ‘sons-of strength’ (construct), the mighty men of Israel. አውሥኡ ‘answered’ (አውሥአ). በአሐዲ ቃል ‘with one voice’. ንሕነሰ ‘as for us’ (ንሕነ ‘we’ + -ሰ contrastive); the -ሰ also in ወገቢርሰ ‘as for doing’ (infinitive ገቢር). ምስሌክሙ ‘with you (pl.)’ though one lady is addressed (a polite plural). ንዜከሮ ‘we shall mention it’ (?) sentences.i: You have drawn us here as your servants, with our lady Zion, the heavenly one, the Ark of the law of God, our God, as they draw a camel laden with precious goods by a little fine thread of ኢዊጥ (?), one that is not cut, on its nose, a halter (?);
sentences.n: ሰሐብክነ ‘you drew us’ (ሰሐበ, 2fs perfect, the ending -ኪ appearing as -ክ- before the suffix -ነ; a 2ms would be ሰሐብከነ (?)), agreeing with the feminine -ኪ of አግብርትኪ and ዘከማኪ: the Queen brought the whole company. ዝየ ‘here’. ከመ አግብርትኪ ‘as your servants’ (አግብርት, plural of ገብር, + -ኪ). ሰማያዊት ‘heavenly’ (feminine, with ጽዮን); ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር ‘ark-of his law, of God’ — the ‘law’ is the Law written in the Ark. The image of a camel led by a thread: በከመ ይስሕብዎ ‘as they draw it’. ዘጽዑን ንዋየ ክብር ‘laden with goods-of glory’ (ጽዑን ‘laden’). ፈትለ ‘thread’ then ኢዊጥ, a word I cannot place (?), perhaps naming the kind of cord; እንተ ኢትትበተክ ‘which is not cut’ (feminine relative, agreeing with ፈትል) closes the clause. ዝማማት ‘halter, bridle’ (?), plural in form. The point is the ease with which the Queen led a great company.

sentences.i: And now do not hold us aloof (?), and do not treat us as foreign merchants, but make us as your servants who wash your feet; for as for us, whether we die or live, we are with you, and we have no hope in the land of our birth except with you and our lady Zion, the holy, heavenly one, the dwelling-place of the glory of God.’
sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ ‘and now’ (-ኒ). ኢትትሀየዩነ ‘do not … us’: I take it as ‘do not treat us as strangers/hold us aloof’ (?), a T-stem of a verb I do not find confirmed. ኢትረስዩነ ‘do not make us’ (ረሰየ, as in unit 7). ነግድ ባዕድ ‘a foreign merchant’ (ነጋዲ; ነግድ is perhaps a collective (?)). አላ ‘but’. የኀፅቡ እገሪክሙ ‘who wash your feet’ (ኀፀበ ‘wash’), the humblest servants’ task. እመኒ ሞትነ ወእመኒ ሐየውነ ‘whether we die or whether we live’ (እመኒ ‘even if’). ብሔረ ሙላድነ ‘land-of our birth’ (construct). ዘእንበለ ኀቤክሙ ‘except with you’. The closing line repeats the Zion formula (ማኅደረ ስብሐቲሁ ለእግዚኣብሔር). The tail ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ is the scribal mark that ends the chapter, kept with the last unit.

glossary.ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died' · noun 'death' in the figura etymologica ከመ ሞተ ኢትሙቱ 'that you not die the death' (?) · death (ሞት, noun, accusative; ነሣእነ ሞተ ወሕይወተ 'we have taken death and life')
glossary.ሞትነ: ሞት — our death (noun + -ነ '1cp our') · also ሞተ — we die, we died (1cp perfect, G, used as a conditional: እመሂ ሞትነ 'whether we die', እመኒ ሞትነ 'even if we die'; m-w-t)
glossary.ሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adj.) · 'good' as a substantive (ዘይረክበከ ሠናይ 'what good will find you')
glossary.ረሰዮሙ: ረሰየ — he made them, set them (3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ርሡኣኒሆሙ: ርሡእ — their elders, aged ones (noun/adjective, plural ርሡኣን + -ሆሙ '3mp their') (?)
glossary.ርትዐ: ርትዕ — what is right, righteousness (noun, accusative)
glossary.ሰሐብክነ: ሰሐበ — you (f.) drew us (2fs perfect, whose ending -ክ- is the form before a suffix, + -ነ '1cp us'; a 2ms would be ሰሐብከነ) (?)
glossary.ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
glossary.ሰገዲ: ሰገደ — bowed down, worshipped (the printed ሰገዲ is not a regular verb form: perhaps a slip for the 3mp perfect ሰገዱ, or an unattested verbal noun or participle) (?)
glossary.ስምዕዮሙአ: ሰምዐ — hear them! (2mp imperative + 3mp suffix -ሙ; the printed -ዮሙ is not the usual -ዎሙ, and the final -አ is stray) (?)
glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
glossary.በምክሮሙ: ምክር — by their counsel (በ- 'by' + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.በቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, in the presence of (በ- + preposition)
glossary.በንስቲት: ንስቲት — by a little, with little (በ- 'with' + noun/adjective, fem. 'little')
glossary.በአሐዲ: አሐዱ — with one (በ- 'with' + numeral 'one', masc.; the printed አሐዲ beside አሐዱ) (?)
glossary.በአማንኬ: አማን — in truth indeed (በ- 'in' + noun 'truth' + emphatic -ኬ)
glossary.በአስተጠናቅቆ: አስተጠናቀቀ — with care (በ- + verbal noun in -ኦ, cf. ተሀውኮ; ṭ-n-q-q) (?)
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.ባዕድ: ባዕድ — another, a stranger (adjective/noun; ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife') · 'strange, foreign' (አማልክተ ባዕድ 'strange gods')
glossary.ብሔረ: ብሔር — land, region (construct 'land of') · accusative 'a land' (ርሑቀ ብሔረ 'far, a land'; the construct reading is the alternative (?))
glossary.ተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — he arose, rose up (3m sg perfect, n-s-ʾ)
glossary.ተግባሮሙ: ተግባር — their work, labour, deeds (noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ተጽሕፈት: ተጽሕፈ — she/it was written (3fs perfect, passive tG-stem of ጸሐፈ)
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ታድኅኖሙ: አድኀነ — she saves them (causative 3fs imperfect, or 2ms, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ትማዕ: ሞዐ — that you overcome (2ms or 3fs subjunctive/jussive; lemma as for ወይመውኡ) (?)
glossary.ትርዕድ: ርዕደ — she trembles, it trembled (3fs imperfect, G, r-ʿ-d; subject ልብ 'heart')
glossary.ትቤሎ: ብህለ — you said to him (2ms perfect ትቤ, the same form as 3fs; defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ '3ms to him') · she said to him (3fs ትቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him', Sarah to Abraham)
glossary.ትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — his command (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the command of God') · his commandment, as a plain object with no owner named after it (ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'you have kept his commandment')
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀቤሆሙ: ኀበ — to them (preposition ኀበ, stem ኀቤ- + -ሆሙ '3mp')
glossary.ኀቤክሙ: ኀበ — to you (preposition, stem ኀቤ- + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ኀያላነ: ኀያል — mighty ones (noun, plural ኀያላን, construct 'mighty ones of')
glossary.ኀይል: ኀይል — strength, might (noun; construct ደቂቀ ኀይል 'sons of strength', i.e. the mighty)
glossary.ነሣእነ: ነሥአ — we have taken (1cp perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ነገሩ: ነገር — his speech, word, matter (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ነግድ: ነጋዲ — merchant (noun; the form ነግድ is perhaps a collective or plural of ነጋዲ, or a form of ንግድ 'trade') (?)
glossary.ንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — as for us (1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ንኡሶሙ: ንኡስ — their small ones, the small of them (adjective as noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አርመሙ: አርመመ — they fell silent (3mp perfect, causative-type stem) (?)
glossary.አስምዖሙ: አስምዐ — he made them hear (causative 3ms perfect of ሰምዐ + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አበዊከ: አብ — your fathers (noun, plural አበው + -ka '2ms your')
glossary.አትክልቲሆሙ: አትክልት — their garden plants, produce (collective noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their', with linking -ቲ-) (?)
glossary.አንቅዕተ: አንቅዕት — springs of (construct) · a spring, singular (አንቅዕተ ማያቲሆሙ 'the spring of their waters'; አንቅዕት is singular)
glossary.አንገሥዎ: አንገሠ — they made him king (causative 3mp perf. with suffix 3ms -ዎ)
glossary.አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
glossary.አዘዙነ: አዘዘ — they commanded us (3mp perfect + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.አግብርቲክሙ: ገብር — your servants (noun, plural አግብርት + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.አግብርትኪ: ገብር — your servants (noun, plural አግብርት + -ኪ '2fs your')
glossary.ኢለየማን: የማን — not to the right (ኢ- + ለ- + noun 'right hand, right')
glossary.ኢትትሀየዩነ: ተሀየየ — meaning uncertain: perhaps 'be remiss toward, hold aloof from' (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp jussive, tG-stem + -ነ '1cp us'; the sense is guessed from the context) (?)
glossary.ኢትትመዐዐነ: ተመዐዐ — that she not be angry with us (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs or 2ms subjunctive, tG-stem + -ነ '1cp us'; the verb is not confirmed) (?)
glossary.ኢትትበተክ: ተበትከ — which is not cut (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs imperfect, passive tG-stem) (?)
glossary.ኢነጽሮ: ነጸረ — nor looking at (ኢ- 'not' + verbal noun in -ኦ, 'looking', taking an accusative object) (?)
glossary.ኢንትገሐሥ: ተገሐሠ — that we not turn aside (ኢ- 'not' + 1cp subjunctive, tG-stem, g-ḥ-ś; after ከመ)
glossary.ኢንግበር: ገብረ — let us not do (ኢ- 'not' + 1cp jussive, G)
glossary.ኢዊጥ: ኢዊጥ — unidentified word (?) (noun or adjective describing the thread; not in the lexicon I can consult) (?)
glossary.ኢያሠነይነ: አሠነየ — we did not do well (ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, causative of ሠነየ 'be good')
glossary.ኢያአትት: አአተተ — he does not remove, put away (?) (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect; as ወያአትት in ch. 27, the stem is not well known) (?)
glossary.ኢያእብድከ: አእበደ — let it not make you foolish (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive, causative + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ኤልምያስ: ኤልምያስ — Elmeyas (proper name; named with Azariah as one of those who adjured them; his office is not given in this unit, and ወአልምያስ below is probably the same man) (?)
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
glossary.እምእለ: እለ — more than those who (እም- comparative + relative pronoun) · from among those who, of those who (እም- partitive; ፩ እምእለ ይቴሐቱ 'one of those who are humbled')
glossary.እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ)
glossary.እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you') · 'since' of time (እምዘ ኀለፉ 'since they passed')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እንስሳሆሙ: እንስሳ — their livestock, flocks (collective noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
glossary.እገሪክሙ: እግር — your feet (noun + -ክሙ '2mp your'; suffix stem እገሪ-)
glossary.ኦወልድየ: ወልድ — O my son (ኦ vocative + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
glossary.ወሀበከ: ወሀበ — he gave you (3ms perfect, G + -ከ 'you', 2ms)
glossary.ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
glossary.ወለኵሉ: ኵሉ — and to all, for all (ወ- + ለ- + ኵሉ)
glossary.ወለኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and to all of them (ወ- + ለ- 'to' + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወሖር: ሖረ — and go! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወመሀርዎ: መሀረ — and teach him! (ወ- + 2mp imperative + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወማኅደረ: ማኅደር — and dwelling-place of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወሰብሑ: ሰብሐ — and they praised (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወበቅድመ: ቅድመ — and before (ወ- + በ- + preposition, with a following construct)
glossary.ወበጽዮን: ጽዮን — and by Zion (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'by' + proper name)
glossary.ወተመይጠት: ተመይጠ — and she turned (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tG-stem)
glossary.ወተዐቅብ: ዐቀበ — and she keeps, guards (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, ʿ-ḳ-b)
glossary.ወተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — and they rejoiced (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወታልህቅ: አልህቀ — and she makes grow (ወ- + causative 3fs imperfect, or 2ms, of ልህቀ 'grow')
glossary.ወታበዝኅ: አብዝኀ — and she multiplies, increases (ወ- + causative 3fs imperfect, or 2ms, of በዝኀ)
glossary.ወትረ: ወትር — always, continually (adverb, accusative; ወ- is part of the word)
glossary.ወትባርክ: ባረከ — and she blesses (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, or 2ms, G)
glossary.ወትከውኖሙ: ኮነ — and she becomes for them (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, or 2ms, G + -ሙ '3mp to them')
glossary.ወትውኅዝ: ወኅዘ — and she/it flows, runs (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G, w-ḫ-z)
glossary.ወኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at (preposition; ወ- 'and') · and where, and wherever (conjunction, ወኀበ ሖረ ይተልዎ 'and wherever he went it pursued him')
glossary.ወነገረ: ነገር — and the affairs of (ወ- + noun, construct 'word, matter of'; the spelling is also that of a verb 'and he said') (?)
glossary.ወነጊረ: ነገረ — and to tell, telling (ወ- + infinitive, accusative)
glossary.ወንንግሮ: ነገረ — and let us tell him (ወ- + 1cp jussive + -ኦ 'him', G)
glossary.ወንዜከሮ: ዘከረ — and we mention it (ወ- + 1cp imperfect, G + -ኦ '3ms it, him') (?)
glossary.ወንግሥትኒ: ንግሥት — and the queen too (ወ- + noun, fem. + emphatic -ኒ)
glossary.ወአለበዉነ: አለበወ — and they made us understand (ወ- + causative 3mp perfect of ለበወ + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወአልብነ: አልቦ — and we have not, there is not for us (ወ- + negative existential አልቦ with -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወአልጒሞ: አልጐመ — and bridling (ወ- + verbal noun in -ኦ, 'to bridle') (?)
glossary.ወአንበብዋ: አንበበ — and they read it (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዋ '3fs her, it')
glossary.ወአንተኒ: አንተ — and you also (ወ- 'and' + 2ms independent pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአክብሮታ: አክብሮት — and honouring her, the honour of her (ወ- + verbal noun of አክበረ + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወአውፅኡ: አውጽአ — and they brought out (ወ- + causative 3mp perfect, of ወጽአ)
glossary.ወአዛርያ: አዛርያስ — and Azariah (ወ- + proper name, spelled without final ስ)
glossary.ወአዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — and Azariah (ወ- + proper name; the Azariah of the earlier parts; named here with Elmeyas, and the two offices ሊቀ ካህናት and ሊቀ ዲያቆናት are not assigned to the two men)
glossary.ወኢለፀጋም: ፀጋም — and not to the left (ወ- + ኢ- + ለ- + noun 'left')
glossary.ወኢትረስዩነ: ረሰየ — and do not make us (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp jussive + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወኢትትገሐሥ: ተገሐሠ — and do not turn aside (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms imperfect/jussive, tG-stem, g-ḥ-ś) (?)
glossary.ወኢአስተምክሖ: አስተምክሐ — and not relying, reliance (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + verbal noun in -ኦ, 'trust in') (?)
glossary.ወኢአንስት: ብእሲት — and not female (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + plural አንስት of ብእሲት 'woman') · and not women, nor women (plural አንስት of ብእሲት; subject of ኢያእብድከ)
glossary.ወኢኮነ: ኮነ — and was/is not (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወእምአምርሕተ: አምርሕት — and from the guidance of (ወ- + እም- 'from' + noun, construct; the noun is not identified, perhaps related to መርሐ 'lead') (?)
glossary.ወእግዝእትነ: እግዝእት — and our lady (ወ- + noun, fem. + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወኳላ: ኳላ — unidentified word (?) (ወ- + noun or other; not found) (?)
glossary.ወኵነኔሁ: ኵነኔ — and his judgment (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወወሀቡነ: ወሀበ — and they gave us (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወወሀቦሙ: ወሀበ — and he gave them (ወ- + 3m sg perfect + -omu, w-h-b)
glossary.ወዐቢዮሙ: ዐቢይ — and their great ones, the great of them (ወ- + adjective as noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወዘርሑቅ: ርሑቅ — and which is far (ወ- + ዘ- relative + adjective ርሑቅ 'far')
glossary.ወዘድኅር: ድኅር — and of the latter, the last (ወ- + ዘ- + ድኅር 'after, behind') (?)
glossary.ወይመውኡ: ሞዐ — and they overcome, conquer (ወ- + 3mp imperfect; the lemma is my best identification, and the printed አ stands where ዐ is expected) (?)
glossary.ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
glossary.ወይብዛኅ: በዝኀ — and may it be many, increase (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, G, b-z-ḫ)
glossary.ወይነብር: ነበረ — and he dwells (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ወይእዜኒአ: ይእዜ — and now (ወ- + adverb + enclitic -ኒ; stray final -አ, a spelling habit of this chapter)
glossary.ወይግረሩ: ገረረ — and may they bow down, yield (ወ- + 3mp jussive; root and meaning inferred from context) (?)
glossary.ወደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — and sons of (ወ- 'and' + plural construct)
glossary.ወገቢርሰ: ገብረ — and as for doing (ወ- + infinitive ገቢር + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወገነዩ: ገነየ — and they did homage, served (ወ- + 3mp perfect)
glossary.ወፀርከ: ፀር — and your enemy (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወፍሬ: ፍሬ — and fruit of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውስቴቱ: ውስተ — within it, in it (preposition ውስተ, stem ውስቴ- + 3ms suffix -ቱ)
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form) · as a noun, 'great ones, notables' (construct, ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'notables of Israel')
glossary.ዘቅሩብ: ቅሩብ — which is near (ዘ- relative + adjective ቅሩብ 'near', masc. sg.)
glossary.ዘቅድም: ቅድም — of the former, the first (ዘ- relative + ቅድም 'before, former') (?)
glossary.ዘቦቱ: በ — who has (ዘ- relative + preposition በ + -ቱ '3ms'; ቦቱ 'in him', expressing possession: 'he who has')
glossary.ዘኀደሩ: ኀደረ — which/where they dwelt (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ዘአምጽኡ: አምጽአ — who brought (ዘ- relative + causative 3mp perfect, of መጽአ)
glossary.ዘኢታፈቅር: አፍቀረ — whom/what she does not love (ዘ- relative + ኢ- 'not' + 3fs imperfect, or 2ms)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘከማኪ: ከማ — who is like you (ዘ- relative + preposition ከማ 'like' + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ዘይትረከብ: ተረክበ — who is found (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, passive tG-stem)
glossary.ዘይኤዝዘነ: አዘዘ — who commands us (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect + -ነ '1cp us') (?)
glossary.ዘጸሐፉ: ጸሐፈ — which they wrote (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ዘጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — what is written (ዘ- relative + passive participle ጽሑፍ)
glossary.ዘጽዑን: ጸዐነ — laden, loaded (ዘ- relative + passive participle ጽዑን of ጸዐነ 'load')
glossary.ዜነዋ: ዜነወ — he told her, announced to her (3ms perfect, G + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ዝማማት: ዝማም — halter, bridle (?) (noun, plural ዝማማት in form)
glossary.ያፈቅርዎ: አፍቀረ — they love him (3mp imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ይሄሉ: ሀሎ — he will be, is present (3ms imperfect, h-l-w)
glossary.ይሰምዕ: ሰምዐ — he hears, listens (3ms imperfect, G, s-m-ʿ; ኵሉ ሕዝብ ይሰምዕ 'all the people listened')
glossary.ይስሕብዎ: ሰሐበ — they draw him/it (3mp imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him, it')
glossary.ይቤሉነ: ይቤ — they said to us (3mp perfect ይቤሉ of the defective verb 'say' + -ነ '1cp to us')
glossary.ይትአመር: ተአመረ — it is known, recognised (3ms imperfect, passive tG-stem, of አእመረ 'know') (?)
glossary.ይትዐወቅ: ተዐወቀ — it is known (3ms imperfect, passive tG-stem of ዐወቀ)
glossary.ይኅድር: ኀደረ — he may dwell (3ms subjunctive, G, ḫ-d-r)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይከውኖ: ኮነ — be, become (3ms imperfect + -ሁ 'to him', 3ms, form -o)
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
glossary.ይወዲ: ወደየ — he puts, sets (3ms imperfect, G, w-d-y)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ገብርዋ: ገብረ — they made it/her (root g-b-r, 3pl + obj) · they did it (ገብርዋ ለእኪት 'they did the evil')
glossary.ጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — written; a writing (passive participle, noun)
glossary.ፍርሀተ: ፍርሀት — fear (construct 'fear of') · also accusative, object: ያአትት ፍርሀተ 'he removes fear'
glossary.ፍትሐ: ፍትሕ — judgment, justice (noun, accusative) · construct 'judgment of' (ፍትሐ ሕዝበ አምላከ እስራኤል 'judgment of the people of the God of Israel')
glossary.ፍኖቱ: ፍኖት — his road, way (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ፍጽመ: ፍጽም — completeness, wholeness (noun, accusative, predicate after ይኩንከ)
glossary.፹፰: ፹፰ — spoken ሰማንያ ወሰመንቱ (sämanya wä-sämäntu) 'eighty-eight' (numeral, chapter number)
